_comment: Simulates what an iOS share extension can send once it reads the page in a WKWebView carrying the user's own Instagram session. Field names are deliberately client-friendly; the extractor aliases them onto envelope fields.
caption: Nonna Maria makes orecchiette by hand in Puglia. Just semolina flour and water, no eggs, rolled and dragged with a knife then shaped over her thumb. She has been doing this for sixty years. #pasta #orecchiette #puglia #handmadepasta #italianfood
